# LoadBrush <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LoadBrush:Int32 file:String, texture_flags:Int32=1, u_scale:Float32=1, v_scale:Float32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | Picture file to use as the texture. |
| `texture_flags` | In | Int32 | `1` | Texture flags, see CreateTexture. Defaults to 1. |
| `u_scale` | In | Float32 | `1` | How often the texture repeats horizontally. Defaults to 1. |
| `v_scale` | In | Float32 | `1` | How often the texture repeats vertically. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** A brush handle, or 0 if the file could not be loaded.

## Description

Makes a brush that has a texture loaded from a picture file as its first layer, and returns it. This is a shortcut for [LoadTexture](LoadTexture), [CreateBrush](CreateBrush) and [BrushTexture](BrushTexture), including the optional [ScaleTexture](ScaleTexture).
